what: an 8 x 8 square swept a full turn round a circle of radius 30 with a 90 degree twist, as a new body (the sweep that closes on itself)
method: twisting about the section centre leaves the section area unchanged and its centre follows the circle, so V = A * 2 pi R = 64 * 2 pi 30 = 12063.7; the 90 degree twist maps the square onto itself, so the end sections meet and the body is one closed ring.
